snippet.title: Sulo the Sidekick - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sulo the Sidekick is a cozy desktop pet building his own career, while you do other things. Help Sulo balance work and play, progress in his job, and spend his earnings on fun rewards!

Music by Jezza Roddy
